description: Amir Loop - auto-arming Stop hook that keeps a session going until the work is done

hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$root" ] || exit 0; case "$root" in [A-Za-z]:*) powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$root/hooks/amir-loop-stop.ps1" ;; *) bash "$root/hooks/amir-loop-stop.sh" ;; esac'
